title: Together Learning Haskell/Plutus in native language Club (Phase 2)

ms.promise:
- Establish "Together Learning Plutus" Club and Accept member registrations.

- Conduct the first workshop - Kick off meeting: 

 + Introduction to the club and its activities

 + Overview of Cardano, Catalyst and the Plutus Course 

 + Dividing members into groups; Assigning lessons to each group.

- Learning Plutus together - Lessons 1-5 with these sessions (One session per week and longer lessons may be split into two sessions):

 + Lesson 1: Introduction to Plutus and Smart Contracts on Cardano

 + Lesson 2: The EUTXO Model and Validator Types in Plutus

 + Lesson 3: Setting Up the Development Environment

 + Lesson 4: Working with the Cardano CLI

 + Lesson 5: Low-Level and High-Level Plutus Validator 

 + Review Lesson 1-5 & Homework Assignment 1
ms.criteria:
1. Member registration and first workshop result:

 a. The information of club members are collected: member name, email address, Telegram ID, GitHub account, assigned group.

 b. A Telegram group is created for members to discuss lessons, ask questions, and share knowledge.

 c. Minimum 15 members to register for the training

2. For learning session:

 a. 6 learning sessions have been conducted, with videos recorded and published on YouTube. Each learning session lasts for 90-120 minutes with least 5 developers participating in 1 online learning session.

 b. 5 Lecture slides are shared on G
ms.report:
1. Member registration and first workshop result:
 a. On May 14, 2025, we held the club's first workshop, two weeks after the opening of the registration form, with the following key content:
 + An introduction to the journey of becoming a developer on the Cardano platform.
 + An overview of the content of the Plutus course.
 + An explanation of the club's operation and organizational structure, as well as the incentive rewards for members.
 + Group assignments and task distribution. An initial count of 16 registered members who are ready to participate, divided into 4 groups.
 Members' information is collected in the "Club members" sheet within the Summary of Club Activities file.
 b. Telegram group for members, including all members club.
2. Learning sessions are scheduled every Wednesday at 20:30 Vietnam time. All the videos/documents are shared publicly for everyone.
 a. 6 recorded videos of the learning sessions
 + Lesson 1: Introduction to Plutus and Smart Contracts on Cardano
 + Lesson 2: The EUTXO Model and Validator Types in Plutus
 + Lesson 3: Setting Up the Development Environment
 + Lesson 4: Working with the Cardano CLI
 + Lesson 5: Low-Level and High-Level Plutus Validator 
 + Review Lesson 1-5 & Homework Assignment 1
 b. 5 lecture slides are shared in the Lecture Slides folder. 
 c. Homework Assignment 1 test results (with scores, comments of reviewers; Github repository) of members are updated in the "HW1-scored" sheet in the file Summary of Club Activities.
3. Additional references:
 + Club activities are summarized in the file Summary of Club Activities.
 + Weekly updates on club activities are posted on the Cardano forum.
